# AI presenter: a photoreal, fictional Mira, lip-synced to her voice

An AI-generated presenter: a photoreal but fictional Mira, generated from a text prompt by daVinci-MagiHuman and lip-synced to her designed Qwen3-TTS voice, then finished with a Magnifito lower third and an always-on AI label. She is not a real person and no photo was used; the clip is labelled as AI-generated on screen.

- Type: AI presenter
- Skill: `magnifito-edit`
- Engine: `lower-third`
- Output: 1920x1080, 8 s, with audio

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Here is an AI-generated presenter clip (presenter/mira-ai.mp4: Mira, a fictional presenter made by daVinci-MagiHuman from a text prompt and lip-synced to her Qwen3-TTS voice; see presenter/mira-ai.json). Finish it for a 16:9 1080p social post: scale it to 1920x1080, add a lower third with name "Mira" and role "AI presenter, Magnifito" from 0.5 s for 5 seconds in the Magnifito colours (dark brown #2b1c17 badge, beige #d8c6b4 accent), and keep an "AI-generated presenter · fictional" label in the top-left corner and a small model credit in the bottom-right for the whole clip (labels.svg, Geist from fonts/), so nobody mistakes her for a real person. Keep her voice.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- 11-ai-presenter
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/11-ai-presenter/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -i presenter/mira-ai.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/source.mp4
mgvideo lower-third work/source.mp4 --name 'Mira' --title 'AI presenter, Magnifito' --start 0.5 --duration 5 --color '#d8c6b4' --bg '#2b1c17' --out work/lower-third.mp4
node rasterize.mjs labels.svg work/labels.png 1920 1080
ffmpeg -i work/lower-third.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex [0:v][1:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v] -map [v] -map 0:a -c:v libx264 -crf 20 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/final.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/final.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
